address: 50 people coming together on May 7, 2005 at the Homewood Suites Hotel in Solon, OH for worship and prayer. The following week, the Lord opened the door for worship at a larger facility, the Red Roof Inn, in Bedford Heights. Two months later AGF moved to the Mediterranean Center also in Bedford Heights, which could accommodate more adults and our Children's ministries. For three years, God blessed us to worship at the beautiful Park Synagogue, in Cleveland Heights, where the church met weekly on a large campus, with ample parking, a spacious auditorium. Today, we worship at a wonderful multi-purpose facility, Lutheran High School East, 3565 Mayfield Rd., in Cleveland Heights, OH 44118
